name: Child of Nature
summary: A fellow Skyborne sees promise in your druidic arts and points you toward Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. He can teach you how to reach the Cenarion Circle’s stronghold in Moonglade.

sections.title: A Druid’s Welcome
sections.body: Your teacher believes the druids of the Cenarion Circle will welcome you and share their knowledge. Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff can show you how to reach their stronghold in Moonglade.

faq.answer: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. He can teach you how to reach Moonglade.

faq.q: Where is the Cenarion Circle’s stronghold?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle’s stronghold is in Moonglade on Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Moonglade?
faq.answer: The druids of the Cenarion Circle can impart their knowledge to you.

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you are told the Cenarion Circle’s druids will welcome you and share their knowledge.
As a druid, you are directed to Turak Runetotem, who can teach you how to reach the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade.

attribution: In-game quest text: Child of Nature
